text:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER: PAGE FIRED — host gpu-node-12 (rack r4). symptom: serial console heartbeat lost; kubelet=NotReady. severity=P1. link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/2965432100

autopager: PagerDuty incident INC-20296 created -> eng-oncall (auto-escalation)

alex: ack. I'm on it, pulling logs and attaching serial console in parallel.

mike: +1 ack. pinging IPMI and serial console from jumphost.

jordan: checking cluster state — running `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-12 -o wide` now.

jordan: output: `gpu-node-12   NotReady   <none>   45d   10.2.3.12   <unschedulable: false>`

priya: seeing uptick in 503s on route `generation-prod-usw2` starting ~2965432000. looking for affected tenants.

alex: serial console is unresponsive from our jumphost. `ipmitool lan print` times out. BMC pings also flaky.

sam-hw: sam-hw here (hardware oncall). I'll attempt a soft power-cycle via BMC. please cordon node first so we don't reschedule during the flip.

alex: running `kubectl cordon gpu-node-12` -> `node/gpu-node-12 cordoned`

alex: planning drain: `kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m` — starting eviction now.

mike: eviction started. several long-running dedicated inference pods on that node, may take a while to gracefully terminate.

priya: confirmed 2 dedicated customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: finlytics) routed to that pool are showing elevated error rates. opening a support note and will notify success.

pagerduty-bot: INC-20296 acknowledged by alex. Escalation notice sent to hardware oncall sam-hw.

sam-hw: BMC responded to ping, attempting soft reboot: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.2.3.12 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle` — timed out at 30s. retrying.

sam-hw: soft reboot attempted twice, still no serial output. looks like node doesn't progress past very early boot — possible kernel oops or NVMe/PCIe hang.

jordan: kubelet logs (from previous run) show repeated NVMe I/O timeouts and kernel watchdogs. snippet:
```
Mar 12 10:12:24 gpu-node-12 kernel: nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout
Mar 12 10:12:25 gpu-node-12 kubelet[1234]: E03012 10:12:25   runtime: container start failed: grpc: error: failed to create container
```

alex: because BMC/reboot didn't restore console and kernel logs point to HW IO errors, we need to failover traffic. Priya, can you flip the route to fallback pool for `generation-prod-usw2`?

priya: performing a gradual switch to fallback gateway/pool now. toggled fallback policy through console, expecting reduced 503s within ~60s.

mike: drain hit pods stuck terminating due to GPU device detach. forcing delete on those stuck pods: `kubectl delete pod <pod-name> --grace-period=0 --force` (doing in small batches).

mike: forced deletes done, cluster autoscaler will spin up replacements from spare capacity.

priya: errors dropped ~70% after fallback. ACME and Finlytics notified with an ETA 30m for hardware RMA update.

sam-hw: created vendor ticket HW-7891 for NVMe/board RMA. tagging oncall and support. continuing diagnostics in parallel.

alex: documented mitigation steps: cordon + drain, forced pod deletion, fallback routing applied. leaving node cordoned and marked for RMA.

jordan: followups: add the NVMe IO/kubelet panic signature to alert rules, increase BMC probe frequency for rack r4, and add a runbook step to auto-failover dedicated inference routes on node NotReady with kernel-variation.

alex: handoff: @mike you'll own incident for next 30m. if node doesn't recover or more tenants impacted, escalate to eng-sre and open an incident report.

mike: taking over, watching metrics and vendor updates. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: AUTOPAGER: incident INC-20296 updated: status=mitigated, impact=partial (subset of dedicated tenants), assigned=mike, vendor_ticket=HW-7891, notes="fallback routing applied; node cordoned; RMA opened"
